ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-filing screening of the parent, the SPC manager and every UBO against: (i) UN Security Council Consolidated Lists; (ii) OFAC SDN List and sectoral sanctions; (iii) EU and UK consolidated financial sanctions; (iv) the Omani NCFI national terrorist-designation and domestic sanctions lists; and (v) FATF High-Risk Jurisdictions monitoring list. PEP status must be declared on the official KYC forms; PEP and close-associate relationships trigger enhanced due diligence, source-of-wealth evidence, and senior-management approval before commercial registration certificate issuance. All screenings must be re-run within 5 business days prior to the MoCIIP registration date, and the same evidence pack must be offered to the onboarding bank for the SWIFT Wire and Standby LC rails.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Invest Easy portal of the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP) — investeasy.gov.om
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The SPC must hold a primary Arabic commercial name; the English/market name is permitted only as a corresponding transliteration recorded alongside the Arabic name in the Commercial Register. The name must identify the legal form as a Single Person Company (شركة شخص واحد) or carry the LLC suffix, must not duplicate an existing registered name or registered trademark in Oman, and must not mislead as to the licensed bunkering activity.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: 'Bank', 'Finance', 'Insurance', 'Takaful', 'Investment' — prior Central Bank of Oman / Financial Services Authority approval mandatory
'Oil', 'Petroleum', 'Gas', 'Energy' — prior Ministry of Energy and Minerals approval mandatory
'National', 'State', 'Government', 'Ministry', 'Public Authority' — implies state affiliation; absolutely prohibited
'Islamic', 'Sharia', 'Hajj', 'Umrah' — prior Ministry of Awqaf and Religious Affairs consent required
Terms of public indecency, religious denigration, or contrary to public order, and any word implying a different legal form ('S.A.O.G.', 'Holding', 'Branch')
Names implying official sponsorship, monopolistic privilege, or charity/waqf status without a statutory license
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Name rejection is delivered through the Invest Easy dashboard with a stated reason (duplicate, prohibited token, missing prior clearance, or transliteration mismatch). The applicant may (a) correct and resubmit the name application online after securing the required ministerial no-objection; or (b) file a formal objection with the MoCIIP Commercial Registry Committee within 15 working days of the rejection notice. Adverse committee decisions may be challenged before the Administrative Court within 60 days of notification pursuant to Royal Decree No. 101/1996 (Administrative Court Law, amended by Royal Decree No. 4/2021). No fee is refunded; resubmission triggers a new 30-day reservation clock.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permitted. A physical, manned registered office in the Sultanate of Oman is mandatory under Royal Decree No. 18/2019 (Commercial Companies Law, Article 8); the Port Authority bunkering license and marine fueling permits require an in-country operational address with dedicated records space. Virtual offices, mail-forwarding addresses and non-physical shared desks will fail both the maritime regulator's and NCFI's commercial-substance review for a Medium_Risk_Enhanced marine fuel activity.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High: estimated 60–75% probability of an unannounced physical inspection within the first 12 months after commercial registration issuance, driven by Port Authority HSE checks, Environment Authority coastal-site visits, and NCFI/maritime-license AML compliance reviews. The SPC must maintain at the registered office: the UBO register, board/manager resolutions, accounting books, the original Commercial Register certificate, and the bunkering license dossier.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Oman Companies Law, Royal Decree No. 18/2019, Articles 267-278 (Single Person Company); Commercial Maritime Law, Royal Decree No. 35/1981; Petroleum and Gas Industry Law, Royal Decree No. 8/2011 (fuel supply licensing basis); Environmental Protection Law, Royal Decree No. 114/2001.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP) - Commercial Registration Directorate, Invest Easy e-portal (https://investeasy.gov.om)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Certificate of Incorporation and Commercial Registration (CR) Application for a Single Person Company, including the notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association (MoA) in Arabic.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital is required for an SPC under RD 18/2019. The sole shareholder declares a nominal capital amount in the MoA and completes full subscription prior to filing. No escrow account or mandatory capital deposit applies at the incorporation stage; foreign owners must evidence a bank account and inward transfer documentation for licensing authorities.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Sole Shareholder hereby adopts the Memorandum and Articles of Association of the Single Person Company and approves the full subscription of the declared share capital. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office of the Company be fixed at [address], Muscat, Sultanate of Oman, effective upon issuance of the Commercial Registration certificate. RESOLVED FURTHER, that [Name] be appointed Chief Executive Officer, and [Name] as Marine Fuel Compliance Manager, each authorised to open bank accounts, execute bunkering supply agreements, apply for the Ministry of Energy and Minerals fuel supply licence, and sign port-service contracts. RESOLVED FURTHER, that officers may affix the Company seal and complete all regulatory and environmental permit applications.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Reservation of Corporate Name and Invest Easy Account Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MoCIIP Commercial Registration Directorate (Invest Easy e-portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Create an investor profile on Invest Easy with passport and residency data. Complete the name availability search using the activity description 'Marine fuel and lubricants supply to vessels (ISIC 5222)'. Submit three alternative names suffixed with 'SPC' in Arabic and English and pay the electronic name reservation fee of OMR 20. Retain the reservation receipt for the MoA filing stage.
required_dossiers: Passport copy of the sole shareholder
Resident card or entry visa (if present in Oman)
Power of attorney of the designated filing agent
Proposed corporate name list (Arabic and English)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the selected name is rejected for similarity or violating branding rules, select alternative names from the search index and re-pay the reservation fee; MoCIIP processes the corrected submission within one additional working day.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarisation of the Articles of Association (MoA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public, Ministry of Justice and Legal Affairs; or Omani Embassy/Consulate for signature abroad
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the SPC MoA in Arabic strictly following the mandatory statutory template and the reserved trade name. The sole shareholder executes the MoA before a Notary Public in Oman, or before an Omani diplomatic post if the shareholder is outside the Sultanate. The notary certifies the signature pages and identity documents; execute two original counterparts, one for the registry and one for the company file.
required_dossiers: Signed MoA in Arabic (two originals)
Passport copies of shareholder and appointed manager
Trade name reservation receipt
Shareholder identity declaration and any power of attorney for an absent signatory
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: In the event of refusal, amend the conflicting clauses (object clause, capital, or activity scope) and re-attest before the same notary; corrected documents are processed within three working days without re-filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of the Commercial Registration Application
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the SPC incorporation application on Invest Easy by selecting the activity code ISIC 5222 'Support services for water transportation - marine bunkering and lubricant replenishment'. Attach the notarized MoA, lease deed of the registered office, and shareholder/manager consent forms. Pay the statutory government fee by e-payment and upload the scanned capital subscription statement. The system auto-generates a submission reference number.
required_dossiers: Notarized MoA (Arabic)
Registered office lease or usufruct contract
Copies of passports and residence permits of shareholder and manager
Capital subscription statement at bank (if any) and inward transfer evidence
Name reservation receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registrar issues a query (e.g., discrepancies in the object clause or lease), submit a corrective annexure within five working days via the 'Complete Filings' module; no penalty applies for corrections made within the free-correction window.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Commercial Registration Certificate and Official Gazette Entry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MoCIIP and the Ministry of Justice Official Gazette
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The application is approved by MoCIIP, generating the Commercial Registration (CR) certificate containing the CR number, name, legal form 'SPC', capital, and the bunkering-related activity code. The registry automatically relays the incorporation notice for publication in the Official Gazette. Download the certified PDF via Invest Easy and retain the sealed copy for all subsequent licensing and tax steps.
required_dossiers: MoCIIP approval letter
Payment receipts (CR fee and publication fee)
Notarized MoA and CR certificate draft
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Seek a formal amendment if the CR contains a spelling error or mismatched ISIC code; MoCIIP issues a corrected CR within two days after submission of the amendment request and explanatory letter.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration (TRN), VAT Registration and Social Protection Fund Enrolment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Oman Tax Authority (OTA); Social Protection Fund (SPF)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the Tax Registration Application on the OTA portal to obtain a Tax Registration Number (TRN) based on the CR and MoA. If the expected taxable supplies exceed the OMR 38,500 annual VAT threshold, concurrently apply for VAT registration. Enrol the company and its employees with SPF (social insurance). Open a corporate bank account at a licensed Oman bank and deposit the declared capital, keeping the remittance advice for the fuel licence application.
required_dossiers: CR certificate and notarized MoA
Passport and resident card of shareholder and manager
Expected turnover declaration for VAT threshold assessment
Bank account confirmation and capital remittance receipts
Employee appointment letters (if any) for SPF enrolment
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If OTA flags inconsistency with CR data, submit a voluntary correction via the OTA e-services and obtain a rectified TRN within 10 working days; late-filing penalties can be waived if reported before the first taxable event.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Commercial Licence and Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry (OCCI) Membership
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Muscat Municipality or relevant regional governorate; Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry (OCCI)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for the Municipal Commercial Licence through the Invest Easy municipal services module or the local municipality counter, referencing the approved CR and lease. Submit the OCCI membership application with the CR and MoA; OCCI issues the Chamber certificate and commercial membership card. The municipal licence must list 'marine fuel supply and bunkering' as the permitted physical activity at the registered office.
required_dossiers: CR certificate and approved MoA
Lease deed and building owner consent
Civil defence site plan (initial submission)
OCCI application form and manager passport copy
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the municipality requires a change of premises classification, file a revised lease or fire-safety attestation within 10 days; OCCI membership issuance is immediate upon clearing the CR fee ledger.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-licence Coordination: Preliminary Bunkering Permit and Port Operator Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Energy and Minerals (MEM) - Petroleum Marketing Directorate; port operator (Port of Sohar / Port of Salalah / Duqm SEZ) and Ministry of Transport, Communications and IT
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File a preliminary bunkering licence application with MEM, attaching the CR, MoA, financial solvency statement, P&I insurance certificate and draft bunker supply agreements. Simultaneously, obtain port operator pre-clearance by presenting the marine operations plan, oil spill contingency plan (OPEP) and berth schedule template. Pay the prescribed licensing and port user fees and obtain a provisional pre-licence letter allowing the company to conclude fuel procurement contracts with OQ Trading or licensed importers.
required_dossiers: CR certificate, MoA and municipal licence
Financial statements or bank solvency letter
P&I Club insurance certificate (entered vessel cover)
Oil Pollution Emergency Plan (OPEP) statement
Draft bunker supply and storage agreements
Port operator clearance forms and security declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If MEM or the port operator rejects the application, align the OPEP and financial guarantees with the required standards, obtain a deficiency letter, and resubmit within 30 days; an industrial appeal may be lodged with the Ministry's Licence Appeal Committee.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Energy and Minerals (MEM) - Petroleum Marketing and Fuel Licensing Directorate, in coordination with the Ministry of Transport, Communications and Information Technology (Maritime Transport Department) and the relevant port authority (Port of Sohar, Port of Salalah, Duqm Special Economic Zone).
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Marine Fuel (Bunkering) Supply and Trading Licence; Vessel-Based Refuelling Service Permit and Port Concessional Bunkering Permit.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environment Authority of the Sultanate of Oman - Department of Environmental Permitting and Conformity (regulatory base: Royal Decree No. 114/2001 Environmental Protection Law and Ministerial Decision 18/1993).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B (Environmental Screening/Registration) for harbour-side bunkering barges and shore-dose operations without major storage. Full EIA (Category A) is required if the company constructs onshore fuel depots exceeding 10,000 tonnes or operates within sensitive coastal zones (e.g., near Ras Al Hadd nature reserve or marine-protected shorelines).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: MARPOL Annex I: zero oily discharge within 12 nm; bilge-water treatment ≤15 ppm before discharge. IMO 2020 marine fuel sulphur cap 0.50% m/m; NOx and SOx per MARPOL Annex VI. VOC vapour loading standard ≤35 g/m³ at bunkering interface. Wastewater BOD ≤40 mg/L and TSS ≤60 mg/L per Omani Ministerial Decision 170/2005; waste-oil and hazardous waste transferred only to licensed facilities under the Environment Authority waste manifest system.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Royal Oman Police - Civil Defence and Ambulance Authority: fire safety certificate for shore offices, hose/loading racks, and bulk fuel storage compounds; hazardous-area classification inspection for explosion-protected electrical equipment on barges and shore installations. Ministry of Labour workplace clearance: occupational safety cards, PPE assessment, and certified health checks for deck personnel. Port-authority medical and security passes plus third-party inspection certificate for cranes, hose-lifting gear, and berth load-bearing structures.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Oman Tax Authority (OTA), an autonomous body under the Ministry of Finance; official English name: Oman Tax Authority; Arabic: الهيئة العامة للضرائب. Portal: https://www.taxoman.gov.om; e-filing/TMS: https://tms.taxoman.gov.om. Customs registration: Royal Oman Police – Directorate General of Customs, e-single-window 'Bayan' at https://bayan.rop.gov.om.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Oman (CBO), acting as the fiat currency authority, foreign exchange regulator, and supervisory body for all licensed banks and exchange houses under the Banking Law (Royal Decree 114/2000) and the CBO Foreign Exchange Regulations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Omani Rial (OMR) is pegged to the US dollar at 1 OMR = 2.6008 USD. Capital account and current account convertibility are permitted through CBO-licensed authorised dealers; profit remittance for a 100% foreign-owned SPC is allowed after annual audited financial statements and Oman Tax Authority clearance are obtained. There are no express CBO quotas on ordinary external transfers; however, banks must collect supporting trade, tax, and corporate documents. The peg anchors monetary stability, but creates US-dollar liquidity sensitivity. Omani regulations impose no blanket approval requirement for foreign direct investment capital entry or for trade-related outbound payments in USD; all flows are reportable via the CBO's electronic foreign exchange monitoring system.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Oman does not mandate surrender or compulsory conversion of export/service-export proceeds into OMR. A bunkering SPC may retain USD or other foreign currency in a licensed onshore Foreign Currency Account. Export receipts, including bunkering revenue for fuel and lubricants sold to international vessels, must be repatriated within 180 days from the service delivery date and must pass through a CBO Authorised Dealer bank. No fixed conversion percentage applies; the bank files the transaction under the CBO balance-of-payments reporting framework supported by the bunker delivery receipt, commercial invoice, and port/customs clearance evidence.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account + Operational USD/OMR Account
Capital Escrow Account + Multi-currency Operational Account
Capital Escrow Account + Operational USD/OMR Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: LOW. Offshore digital EMI platforms and non-bank payment firms (e.g., Wise, Airwallex, Payoneer) are not viable as primary treasury rails for an Omani corporate SPC. They are not licensed by the CBO, cannot provide OMR-denominated accounts, are not connected to the CBO electronic reporting system, and are not authorised dealers for maritime trade settlement. Such platforms may only be used for inconsequential ancillary foreign payments, and only if the funds ultimately flow through a CBO-licensed bank; using them as the main clearing channel would breach the Omani regulatory expectation that all corporate receipts and disbursements occur through a locally authorised bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical onboarding is mandatory in practice. At least one director or a fully authorised attorney must appear in person at the chosen Omani bank branch or head office for the initial KYC interview. Non-resident shareholders may execute a notarised and apostilled power of attorney, but the attorney must still appear physically. Some banks permit remote video KYC for additional signatories after the initial in-person process, but the first onboarding step for a newly established foreign-owned SPC cannot be completed exclusively remotely. The SPC must provide a registered physical office address in Oman, a valid lease or ownership proof, and, for bunkering operations, a port agreement, terminal access letter, or declared operational base at an Omani anchorage.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opaque ultimate beneficial ownership through an offshore intermediate holding entity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified and notarised corporate registry extracts for each intermediate layer; full ownership-structure chart; authenticated UBO declarations; passport copies of every qualifying beneficial owner (10% or more); proof of source of funds for the capital contribution; and an explanatory commercial rationale for the SPC structure.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Vessel-related sanctions exposure due to operations on international waterways and possible OFAC/UN/EU/HMT listed charters or cargoes.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete vessel dataset including IMO number, maritime mobile service identity, flag state, ownership registry, ISM/ISPS certificates, AIS track logs, charter-party contracts, voyage instructions, and automated sanctions-screening reports generated before every transaction; plus a document trail showing denial screening results and post-supply traceability to the receiving ship.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk trade-based money-laundering indicators from frequent bunker purchases and sales to third-country traders lacking direct physical control over the fuel.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed bunker supply agreements, purchase orders, invoices, barge/vessel delivery tickets, independent quantity surveyor certificates, meter calibration records, and third-party price benchmark references (Platts/Argus) to prove commercial reasonableness and no over/under-invoicing.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Rapid or unexplained disbursement patterns and concentrations of outbound wires to jurisdictions with weak AML regimes.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Approved board payment matrix, cash-flow forecast, documented invoice and delivery controls, trade-credit agreements or LC confirmations, bank reference from counterparties, enhanced due diligence packages for each beneficiary, and a written internal anti-money-laundering procedure manual.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inadequate source-of-wealth verification for the shareholder's capital injection into the Omani SPC.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited financial statements of the parent entity for at least two years, bank reference letter from the remitting bank covering account history and transaction turnover, shareholder source-of-wealth statement, board resolution approving the injection, and proof that the funds are not derived from shell entities or undocumented cash.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax-haven residence or hidden commercial nexus of counterparties, particularity of a foreign trader of unknown substance.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Enhanced counterparty KYC: passport, proof of business address, valid trade licence, audited financial statements, FATCA/CRS classification, corporate registry certificate, signed no-shell-company declaration, and a documentary trail confirming the trading counterparties are operating with genuine marine-fuel licenses and assets.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The foreign shareholder initiates a SWIFT MT103 credit transfer from its home bank to the SPC's Capital Escrow Account at a CBO-licensed authorised dealer in Oman. The wire must identify the beneficiary as the OM SPC with its Commercial Registration number and state the payment purpose as 'Equity Investment in Omani Single Person Company' (CBO code P08 — Direct Investment Equity Capital). The receiving bank performs mandatory sanctions screening, verifies that the remitter name exactly matches the shareholder in the company registry, confirms the account title and transaction amount match the authorised share capital, and obtains a source-of-funds declaration. After value is received, the bank files the transaction in the CBO electronic system and issues a foreign investment notification form for onward submission to the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion. The funds may be held in a capital escrow account until the commercial registration is final, then transferred to the operational account.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlement is componentised across three rails: (i) direct SWIFT MT103 for spot bunker fuel purchases and urgent supplier payments, (ii) commercial documentary letters of credit (MT700) issued under UCP600 for term financing of refined fuel and lubricant procurement, and (iii) standby letters of credit (MT760) to secure performance or supply obligations with terminals, refineries, or marine fuel traders. USD is the settlement currency for all international bunker supply contracts, while OMR is used for domestic marina or port disbursements. Every outbound payment requires a defined portfolio with the SPC's authorised bank, an underlying invoice or delivery ticket, and threshold reporting to the CBO. Settlement is cleared via SWIFT for USD and via the domestic payment infrastructure for OMR-denominated local items.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/OMR FX spot contracts on the onshore interbank market
USD/OMR FX outright forward contracts with tenors up to 12 months for matching bunker purchase and resale cash flows
USD/OMR FX swap contracts for cash-flow rollover and working capital optimisation
Cross-currency interest rate swaps (USD/OMR) when linked to authorised bank debt or project finance
Offshore non-deliverable forward (NDF) transactions on USD/OMR only with explicit written CBO approval and solely for hedging a committed exposure arising from the bunkering trade book

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual audited financial statements and annual return filed with the Commercial Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP) - Commercial Registry, Invest Easy portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 3 months of financial year-end (on or before March 31 for a December 31 year-end)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine up to OMR 500 per month of delay; sustained default triggers CR suspension and administrative strike-off of the SPC.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return, audited financial statements and supporting tax schedules
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months of tax year-end (on or before April 30 for a calendar tax year)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fixed OMR 500 late-filing penalty plus OMR 100 per day of delay; best-judgment assessment and 1% monthly late-payment interest on unpaid tax.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually before CR expiry on each registration anniversary (renewal permitted up to 30 days in advance)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-renewal surcharge up to OMR 200; a CR lapsed beyond 12 months results in deregistration from the commercial register.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Municipal business license renewal for ship bunkering and marine lubricant supply operations
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually, concurrent with CR renewal, before expiry of the municipal license year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines and a possible cessation order against the licensed office and storage premises.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: PASI monthly contribution returns and annual salary declaration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Monthly returns by the 15th of the following month; annual declaration within 1 month of the fiscal year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 2% monthly surcharge on overdue contributions plus personal recovery action against directors.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) register confirmation and Real Beneficiaries statement
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually at CR renewal and within 15 days of any shareholding or beneficial-ownership change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines up to OMR 5,000 under the Commercial Companies Law and AML/CFT regime for inaccurate or unmaintained UBO records.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Unconditional: every Omani commercial company, including a Single Person Company, must appoint at least one licensed Omani auditor and submit audited financial statements annually regardless of revenue, assets, or employee count.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS in full (large and medium enterprises) or Omani Financial Reporting Standards (small entities), as accepted by the Oman Tax Authority and MoCIIP under the Commercial Companies Law (Royal Decree 18/2019).

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SPC must maintain a Real Beneficiaries register at its registered office; any share transfer or UBO change must be recorded within 15 days and re-confirmed annually in the CR renewal filing; an unrecorded share transfer is ineffective against third parties and attracts registry penalties.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 600 - 1,500 per year (registered office, local PRO and licensed agent representation)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,500 - 5,000 per year (licensed Omani audit firm for a medium marine bunkering supply operation)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 15% of taxable income (Income Tax Law as promulgated by Royal Decree No. 9/2023, effective for tax years commencing on or after 1 January 2024)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No sector-specific tax holiday for marine bunkering or logistics activities in Oman. A 0% rate applies to the first OMR 100,000 of annual taxable income only for qualifying small businesses with gross turnover below OMR 1,000,000 and prescribed employee thresholds; the licensed foreign-controlled bunkering SPC will not ordinarily qualify because of high invoice turnover, and the standard headline 15% therefore applies. A unilateral Foreign Tax Credit is available for foreign-source income taxed abroad, and no state-level or municipal corporate surtax is levied in the Sultanate.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Provisional Corporate Income Tax Return (SGT Form P-1) filed electronically through the Oman Tax Portal operated by the Secretariate-General of Taxation.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within three months of the fiscal year-end (e.g., 31 March for an SPC with a 31 December year-end), accompanied by an estimate of annual taxable income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Estimated gross taxable income from Omani-source marine fuel and lubricant sales (OMR)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Declare projected bunker sales net of expected deductible operating costs; income from refueling performed in Omani territorial waters is wholly Omani-source even if invoiced overseas

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Estimated corporate income tax due at 15% (or 0% small business band where applicable)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: First instalment of federal corporate tax is payable with the provisional return; failure to pay attracts delay interest

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late provisional filing triggers a fixed administrative penalty of OMR 100 per month of delay, capped at 25% of the final assessed tax, plus monthly delay interest of 1% on the under-deposited instalment.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Final Corporate Income Tax Return (SGT Form C-1) with audited IFRS financial statements and related-party transaction schedules; lodged through the Oman Tax Portal e-filing system.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: No later than six months after the fiscal year-end (e.g., 30 June of the year following a 31 December fiscal year-end), with full self-assessed tax paid at filing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenue from ship bunkering, fuel refueling, and marine lubricant replenishment (OMR)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report full invoiced gross proceeds for all deliveries to vessels at anchor or at berth within Omani territorial waters and exclusive economic zone lifting, including sales through chartered barges and supply lighters

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cost of goods sold (bunker fuel purchases, port handling, water taxi/lighters, freight)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must be supported by invoices and set at arm's length for related-party suppliers; related-party marine diesel purchases are tagged in Schedule TP with Platts Mideast Gulf benchmark references

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating expenses (crew payrolls, port dues, vessel survey, insurance, depreciation, professional fees)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deductible only when wholly and exclusively incurred for Omani taxable income; head-office recharges must evidence actual services and arm's-length margins
Add back any 10% withholding tax borne on behalf of a foreign parent, fines, donations without receipt, and provisions that are not statutory or contractually certain

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income before loss set-off (Box 1 minus Box 2 minus Box 3 plus Box 4)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Computed in Omani Rials; no deduction is permitted for foreign branch losses allocable outside Oman
Loss relief is only available for tax periods after the effective date of the new Income Tax Law and subject to continuity-of-business and ownership tests

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Corporate income tax at 15% (with 0% applied to the first OMR 100,000 for qualifying small businesses)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The SPC is taxed at entity level on net taxable income only; retained profits are not taxable beyond this levy
Support with Tax Residence Certificates and foreign assessment evidence; credit is capped at the Omani tax attributable to the same foreign-source income

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Provisional tax deposits and prior overpayments credited
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply the P-1 instalment paid during the year

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final tax due or refundable amount
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Pay immediately through the Oman Tax Portal bank payment rails or the clearance certificate will be withheld

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of the final return incurs a fixed penalty of OMR 100 per month, capped at 25% of the final assessed tax, plus monthly delay interest of 1% on outstanding tax. Fraudulent or false declaration engages an evasion fine of 100% to 200% of abated tax and criminal referral. If the SPC fails to file at all, the Secretariate-General of Taxation issues a Best Judgment Assessment at 15% of estimated gross sales without deduction for unsubstantiated expenses.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% statutory dividend withholding tax on distributions and profit shares paid or credited to non-resident shareholders of the Oman SPC. The tax is a final levy and must be withheld at source by the SPC and remitted to the Secretariate-General of Taxation within 14 days of the distribution. Distributions to Omani resident shareholder companies are generally outside the withholding net.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: A non-resident shareholder claiming a reduced treaty rate must: (i) obtain a Tax Residence Certificate (TRC) for the calendar year of distribution in its home jurisdiction; (ii) file SGT Treaty Relief Form T-2 with the Oman SPC before the dividend is declared and transfer instructions are issued; (iii) await SGT approval of the reduced rate (a clearance certificate specifies the remittable amount and the residual WHT); (iv) retain the approved Form T-2 for audit. Under most Oman double taxation agreements a 10% domestic rate is reduced to 5% where the beneficial owner holds at least 10% of the SPC's capital and, under certain treaties, to 0% where a corporate shareholder holds 25% or more; the Oman-GCC treaty regime confers a 0% dividend rate between GCC resident beneficial owners.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Domestic law imposes 10% WHT on contractual interest, royalties, technical fees, management fees, and service consideration paid to non-residents. Treaty relief may reduce interest to 0% (e.g., interest on bank financing covered by most Oman DTAs) and royalties to 5%-10%; bunkering-related ship charter hire paid to a foreign related party is generally classified as business income and is taxable in Oman only if the foreign recipient carries on a permanent establishment in the Sultanate, otherwise the 10% service withholding applies to pure technical/licensing fees.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Under the Omani Transfer Pricing Rules introduced by the 2023 Income Tax Law and the SGT Transfer Pricing Guidelines, the SPC must prepare and retain a Local File and contemporaneous arm's-length documentation where aggregate related-party transactions exceed OMR 1,000,000 per annum; a Master File is additionally required where the worldwide group's consolidated revenue exceeds OMR 50,000,000 or where aggregate controlled transactions in Oman exceed OMR 5,000,000 per annum.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: Comparable Uncontrolled Price (CUP) — the mandated method for commodity marine fuel purchases and sales, benchmarked against Platts Mideast Gulf bunker price assessments (380cst/0.5%S, HSFO, VLSFO) with quantity, credit, and delivery adjustments
Resale Price Method — for distribution of marine lubricants if the SPC acts as a marketing/dispensing intermediary
Cost Plus Method — for incidental lightening and supply-logistics services rendered to related parties
Transactional Net Margin Method (TNMM) — as a fallback for low-risk toll-like refueling services
Profit Split Method — for integrated joint venture supply arrangements with foreign bunker traders
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Oman does not operate a separate Economic Substance Regulations code as enacted in the UAE, but the Income Tax Law, the General Anti-Abuse Rule, the place of effective management definition, and the Beneficial Ownership registration framework impose equivalent substance thresholds. The SPC is required to demonstrate in Oman: local registered office and bank accounts, executive decision-making and operational control, employees or service contracts with Omani crew, ownership or long-term charter of bunker barges, and risk absorption. A non-resident-owned mailbox SPC without local substance is vulnerable to GAAR recharacterization, treaty-benefit denial, 10% WHT without relief, and simultaneous taxation in the parent jurisdiction.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate omission of Omani-source bunker turnover through invoicing to foreign shell buyers, maintenance of hidden collection accounts outside Oman, backdated offsetting invoices, or fictitious cost deductions from non-existent logistics suppliers.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fine from 100% to 200% of the evaded tax plus monthly delay interest of 1%; assessment on a best-judgment basis with denial of deduction for unsubstantiated costs; criminal referral under the Income Tax Law and Oman Penal Code exposing the SPC to imprisonment of the responsible natural persons of up to three years, confiscation of vessel loads and bank balances.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Where the SPC is operated as a facade, the tax administration may pierce the corporate veil: directors and foreign shareholders become jointly and severally liable for unpaid corporate tax, interest and evasion fines. Personal civil restitution, asset freeze orders over personal bank accounts, travel bans, and detention of the beneficial owner pending tax payment are available remedies.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Absence of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The SPC is registered in Oman but has no office, no Omani employees, no charter agreements for bunker barges, no board meetings or purchase negotiations in the Sultanate, and distributed profits are remitted abroad immediately without an approved clearance certificate.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: GAAR recharacterization and denial of treaty benefits; mandatory 10% WHT applied to every dividend and service remittance with no relief; cancellation of the SPC's Commercial Registration; Beneficial Ownership declaration fines up to OMR 10,000; exclusion from Oman's maritime bunkering license registry.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are jointly liable for the unpaid withholding tax and for corporate income tax after administrative strike-off; civil courts may issue travel bans, prohibit the foreign owner from repatriating proceeds, and attach the personal movable assets of the natural-person beneficial owner, including vessels and vehicles.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Purchasing marine fuel from a related trader above the OMR 1,000,000 threshold without CUP benchmarking against Platts Mideast Gulf; booking group management fees equal to a percentage of bunker turnover without evidence of actual services; failure to prepare and submit the Local File / Schedule TP within the statutory time frame.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Adjustment of taxable income to the arm's-length result with an additional tax surcharge of 25% of the extra assessment; monthly delay interest of 1% from the original return due date; fixed fines for documentation default ranging from OMR 1,000 to OMR 20,000 per unproduced record; criminal referral for falsified back-to-back invoices.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: A director who signs the transfer pricing declaration or directs the inflated related-party pricing is jointly and severally liable for the additional corporate tax and surcharge. The Omani courts have upheld orders attaching directors' personal bank guarantees and imposing interdiction from leaving the Sultanate until the adjustment, interest and fines are settled.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Withholding Tax Non-Compliance on Profit Repatriation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Distributing dividends to a non-resident shareholder without deducting 10% WHT, paying foreign parent royalties and technical fees under misdescribed labels, or transferring funds overseas without the SGT clearance certificate and Form T-2 treaty approval.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Unpaid WHT becomes a statutory first-ranking charge over the SPC's assets; penalty of OMR 100 per month on late remittance plus 1% monthly interest; disallowance of the underlying expense if the WHT is not remitted; rejection of treaty relief for all future profit transfers.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are deemed tax-facilitation officers: they are jointly, severally, and personally liable for the withheld but unremitted 10% WHT. Enforcement action includes personal asset attachment, prohibition on departure from Oman, and imprisonment for up to two years for willful non-payment of a government levy.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Trade-Based Money Laundering and Sanctions Evasion (AML)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Cash-layered settlement of marine fuel deliveries, systematic over- or under-invoicing of bunker volumes relative to certified delivery notes, refueling of vessels ultimately owned by sanctioned or sanctioned-state entities, use of irrevocable standby LCs issued through shell banks in third countries to disguise the true payer, and failure to register the SPC as a reporting entity with the Oman Financial Intelligence Unit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: AML Law (Royal Decree No. 30/2016, as amended): fines up to OMR 1,000,000 for corporate entities; confiscation of the full cargo and sale proceeds; revocation of the bunkering license; joint referral to the Public Prosecution where the lead offenders face imprisonment of up to seven years and additional money-laundering fines of up to OMR 100,000 per founder.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal liability extends to directors, the AML compliance officer, and the beneficial owner who orchestrated the scheme. Sanctions include blacklisting on the SDN and national terrorist lists, travel bans, extradition requests, criminal confiscation of personal property (including yachts and residential real estate owned in Oman), and imprisonment of up to seven years without the option of a fine.
